paper.title: Time-Uniform Self-Normalized Concentration for Discounted Least Squares: Limits and Corrections

settings.out_of_scope_reason: The paper studies time-uniform self-normalized concentration for discounted least squares, not a regret or identification guarantee for a bandit problem.
unmapped: Objective is a lower bound on any valid deterministic anytime concentration boundary for the discounted self-normalized process |S_t^gamma|/sqrt(tilde V_t^gamma), not regret
Discount factor gamma in (0,1) and ridge regularization lambda > 0 are fixed
Action set is {1}, theta* = 0, X_t = 1 for all t
settings.definition_quote: Take \(d=1\), \(L=1\), \(\theta^*=0\), \(X_t=1\) for all $t\ge 1$, and \(\lambda>0\). Let \((\eta_t)_{t\geq1}\) be independent random variables satisfying \(\eta_t\sim\mathcal N(0,R^2)\).

symbols.Phi_inv: inverse of the standard normal CDF
symbols.C_T: any deterministic common boundary level valid for max_{t<=T} |S_t^gamma|/sqrt(tilde V_t^gamma) with prob >= 1-delta

conditions: scalar Gaussian process with X_t = 1, eta_t ~ N(0, R^2) i.i.d.

source.label: Prop:finite-horizon-lower-bound
source.quote: Consider the same scalar Gaussian process as in \cref{Eq:counterexample-recursion}. Fix \(T\geq1\) and \(\delta\in(0,1)\). Let \(C_T(\delta)\) be any deterministic boundary satisfying \mathbb P(\max_{1\leq t\leq T} |S_t^\gamma|/\sqrt{\widetilde V_t^\gamma} \leq C_T(\delta)) \geq1-\delta. Then C_T(\delta) \geq \frac{R}{(1+\gamma)\sqrt{\lambda+(1-\gamma^2)^{-1}}}\Phi^{-1}(\frac{1+(1-\delta)^{1/T}}{2})

results.notes: Lower bound on the size of a confidence boundary (concentration), not regret; quantity 'other'. R is the Gaussian noise standard deviation, mapped to sigma_std.

symbols.c_gl: positive constant depending on gamma and lambda

conditions: scalar Gaussian process with X_t = 1, eta_t ~ N(0, R^2)

source.label: Prop:finite-horizon-lower-bound
source.quote: In particular, for fixed \(\gamma\) and \(\lambda\), there are positive constants \(c_{\gamma,\lambda}\) and \(x_0\) such that, for \(\delta\in(0,1/2]\) and \(T/\delta\geq x_0\), C_T(\delta)\geq c_{\gamma,\lambda}R\sqrt{\log\frac{T}{\delta}}.

results.notes: Lower bound on the running envelope of any valid deterministic anytime boundary. Corollary 1 gives the same bound for B_t(delta) of nondecreasing anytime boundaries at every time t (not recorded separately).
